title: Yonder
summary: YON, YOND, YONDER adjective [G.] Being at a distance within view. Yonder men are too many for an embassy. Read thy lot in yon celestial sign. Yon flowery arbors, YONDER alleys green. YON, YOND, YONDER

inlines.v: YON, YOND, YONDER adjective [G.] Being at a distance within view. Yonder men are too many for an embassy. Read thy lot in yon celestial sign. Yon flowery arbors, YONDER alleys green. YON, YOND, YONDER, adverb At a distance within view. When we use this word, we often point the hand or direct the eye to the place or object. First and chiefest, with thee bring him that yon soars on golden wing. Yonder are two apple women scolding.
